summary: GEO Group filed an 8-K reporting the completed sale of its Adelanto Complex (1,280-bed Adelanto West, 660-bed Adelanto East, and 704-bed Desert View ICE processing facilities in Adelanto, California) to the U.S. Department of Homeland Security for $950 million cash. The Purchase and Sale Agreement was signed and closed concurrently on October 2, 2026, with net proceeds expected near $705 million after taxes and fees. Proceeds will fund debt reduction and share repurchases. GEO continues managing the facilities under its existing ICE contract through December 19, 2034, including a five-year option. Watch for further facility sales to ICE.
